# @vllnt/convex-quota

> TypeScript Convex component for quotas and allowances: daily, weekly, monthly, rolling or epoch reset windows per user or key, with a readable remaining count.

`@vllnt/convex-quota` is a Convex component (`convex@^1.45.0`, Node `>=22.12.0`, ESM only). It stores one sandboxed allowance row per `(scope, subjectRef, key)` with `used`, the last allowed `limit`, the `periodKey`, the window policy and the window start and end. The `Quota` client has `consume(ctx, subjectRef, key, limit, window, { amount?, scope? })` returning `{ allowed, used, remaining, limit, periodKey, resetsAt }`, `remaining(ctx, subjectRef, key, limit, window, scope?)` returning the same without `allowed`, `refund(ctx, subjectRef, key, amount, periodKey, scope?)` returning `{ refunded, used, remaining }`, and `eraseSubject(ctx, subjectRef, scope?, batch?)` returning the rows deleted in its first pass. Windows are `calendar` (`day`, `week` or `month` in an IANA `timeZone`, weeks start Monday unless `weekStartsOn: "sunday"`), `rolling` (starts at the first allowed consume) or `epoch` (`floor(now / durationMs)` buckets). Time is read on the server. Refs and scopes are 1 to 256 UTF-16 code units; limits, amounts and durations are positive safe integers. A key's window policy cannot change (`POLICY_MISMATCH`); its limit can. `consume` and `refund` are not idempotent: pair them with `@vllnt/convex-idempotency` in the same host mutation. `refund` only applies to the stored, unexpired `periodKey`, otherwise it returns `refunded: false`. `remaining` is a query snapshot: a subscription does not refresh when the window resets on its own. The host owns auth, the meaning of refs and keys, and every limit; the component owns the allowance row and the window math.

## When to use

- Use it when a user, API key or tenant gets a number of actions per calendar day, week or month in a given IANA timezone, and the UI shows how many are left and when they reset.
- Use it when an allowance resets on a rolling duration that starts at first use, or on fixed epoch-aligned buckets such as every hour.
- Use it when a cancelled action should give its units back within the same window.
- Do not use it for throttling or rate limiting of bursts: use `@convex-dev/rate-limiter`.
- Do not use it when the count never resets: a balance that is spent and topped up (`@vllnt/convex-wallet`), or an API key's lifetime use limit (`@vllnt/convex-api-keys`).
- Do not use it for billable usage records rolled up per billing period: use `@vllnt/convex-metering`.

## For coding agents

Docs for the installed version ship in the package: `README.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`, this `llms.txt`, `docs/API.md` and typed `src/` under `node_modules/@vllnt/convex-quota/`. Read them before writing code.

## Docs

- [README](./README.md): Install, quick start, API table, common tasks, errors, limits, compatibility
- [API Reference](./docs/API.md): Exact signatures, defaults, result shapes and window rules
- [Error codes](./docs/API.md#error-codes): Every `ConvexError` code, its message and which method throws it
- [Errors and fixes](./README.md#errors-and-fixes): The same codes, with the cause and fix for each
- [Changelog](./CHANGELOG.md): Version history and release notes
- [License](./LICENSE): MIT license

## Optional

Repository only, not in the npm package:

- [Example wrapper](https://github.com/vllnt/convex-quota/blob/main/example/convex/example.ts): Unauthenticated test fixtures, not production endpoints
- [Example tests](https://github.com/vllnt/convex-quota/blob/main/example/convex/example.test.ts): `convex-test` integration tests, not real OCC proof
- [Idempotency tests](https://github.com/vllnt/convex-quota/blob/main/example/convex/idempotency.test.ts): `consume` and `refund` made retry-safe with `@vllnt/convex-idempotency`
- [Contributing](https://github.com/vllnt/convex-quota/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): Development setup, validation commands, release workflow
- [Security Policy](https://github.com/vllnt/convex-quota/blob/main/SECURITY.md): Vulnerability reporting policy
